name: hilda
description: Sixty years of global land use change, visualised and modelled. HILDA+ reconstructs annual land use/cover for the whole planet from 1960 to 2019 at 1 km in six classes; this module pulls single years out of PANGAEA's 4.5 GB archive with HTTP range requests, reduces them to a 0.5 degree cube, and serves them three ways: longitudinally as area curves per region, spatially as classified grids plus full 1 km windows on demand, and as a cellular automaton whose transition rates are counted from the HILDA+ transition layers and scored against what actually happened. Eight-bit console. Public CC-BY-4.0 data, no keys.
